structured_output.summary: The draft follows UI_RULES §12 closely, but AC1 can't be met with the current S6 layout. At 844×390 the card row's content box is about 490.7px wide (844 minus the one-third title panel, minus the 24px left and 48px safe-right padding), while five 96px cards plus four 8px gaps need 512px. Making it fit takes a layout change that UI_RULES doesn't cover, and so does stopping the nowrap BEST line from clipping at 96px. The owner needs to decide these before a builder can do the five-card part.

findings.claim: AC1 (and done_when's '5 cards fit unscrolled') can't be met with the current S6 geometry. .ui-start__brand takes flex-basis 100%/3 (281.3px) and .ui-start__select pads 24px left plus var(--safe-right) = 48px right (title.css:90, tokens.css:91), so the row's content box is about 490.7px. Five cards at the 96px minimum plus 4 × space.s2 gaps need 512px. To fit, the builder would have to make up a layout change (a narrower title panel, smaller padding or gaps). UI_RULES §12 and the S6 mockup don't cover that.
findings.suggestedFix: Leave the five-cards-fit criterion out until the owner answers the design request. Keep the four-card fit and everything from the minimum width up: AC3/AC4 scroll, snap, peek and RACE fixed; the shake, reduced-motion and rest criteria. Keep the five-card stage only if the owner's answer allows it, or show five cards scrolling at 96px without claiming they fit.

findings.claim: At 96px a card's plate content is about 72px (96 − 2×4px outline − 2×8px padding). .ui-track-card__best is white-space: nowrap (title.css:182), and 'BEST 0:40.37' in the 13px Barlow Condensed label with 0.12em tracking already needs most of the ~92px it gets at today's ~116px four-card width. At the minimum width the BEST line will clip. UI_RULES §12 only says names wrap and never clip. It says nothing about the BEST line, so AC1's 'no BEST text clipped' would push the builder to invent a treatment (wrap the time onto its own line, a smaller type size, less padding).
findings.suggestedFix: Leave out any criterion that asserts the BEST line is unclipped at the minimum card width until the owner says how BEST behaves at 96px (see designRequest). The existing four-card no-clip test (tests/ui/track-select-fit-phone.test.ts) must still pass unchanged.

findings.claim: AC2 mostly restates behaviour that already holds on main. Today the four 'start--menu' cards share flex: 0 1 360px with min-width 0, so they are equal and about 116px wide, and text-overflow defaults to clip. The criterion only fails on main because of its tacked-on 'new five-cards stage renders' clause.
findings.suggestedFix: Merge the stage-renders check into whichever criterion first uses the new stage. Keep the four-card checks as a regression guard in the same test file, not as their own AC.

findings.claim: AC8 (a locked card rests on hover and press) already holds on main. title.css:195-200 sets transform: none on [aria-disabled='true']:hover/:active, and that rule wins over the lift rule by source order. The test only fails on main because the many-cards stage doesn't exist yet. It is a fair guard, since done_when lists it, but it isn't new behaviour.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep it as a guard that the shake doesn't break the locked card's rest pose. Note that a test using the existing 'start--menu' stage would pass on main. Pair it with the shake test, or keep using the new stage so it fails on main.

findings.claim: Some builder details aren't stated. Space on a focused role=radio div must call preventDefault, or the page or scroller scrolls. Clicking a locked card that has tabindex -1 focuses it. The shake must not restart badly or pile up on repeated taps. It isn't stated whether 'easing snap' applies to the whole 250ms animation or to each swing; AC5 checks one 250ms animation with the snap easing.
findings.suggestedFix: Say: one Web Animation over the whole 250ms with easing var(--ease-snap) from tokens, keyframes 0 → +4 → −4 → +4 → 0 (three swings), cancel any running shake before starting a new one, and preventDefault on Space and Enter.

structured_output.designRequest: Track select (S6), card row at 844×390, follow-up to UI_RULES §12. (1) The 96px minimum and 'five cards fit unscrolled' (B14 done_when) don't fit together with today's layout. The title panel takes one third of the width (about 281px), and the select area pads 24px left and 48px safe-right, which leaves about 490.7px for cards. Five cards at 96px plus four 8px gaps need 512px. Which should change: a narrower title panel at five or more cards, a smaller right padding or card gap, a lower minimum width, or should five cards scroll on the phone? (2) At 96px a card's plate has about 72px for text. The 'BEST 0:40.37' line (13px label, 0.12em tracking, nowrap) doesn't fit there. Should BEST wrap the time onto its own line, use a smaller size, drop the 'BEST' word, or should the plate padding shrink at the minimum width?
backlogChangeRequests: B14 done_when '4 and 5 cards fit unscrolled at 844×390' contradicts the 96px minimum in UI_RULES §12 under the current S6 layout (about 490.7px row, 512px needed). Restate it after answering the design request, e.g. '4 cards fit; 5 fit if <layout change>' or '5 cards scroll at 96px'.
